description_en: Queries the list of O&M tickets pending approval
description_zh: 获取需要审批的运维申请列表
name: ListOperationTickets

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 1000. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
We recommend that you specify a value for the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为1000。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The address of the O&M asset for exact search
parameters.help_zh: 精确搜索待审批的运维资产地址
parameters.name: asset_address

parameters.help_en:
The approval status. Valid values:
1: Pending approval.
2: Processed
parameters.help_zh: 审批状态 1 待审批。2 已处理
parameters.name: approval_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the O&M ticket
parameters.name: operation_ticket_id

OperationTickets.description_en: The list of O&M tickets pending approval
OperationTickets.description_zh: 待审批的运维申请列表

ApplyUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who submitted the O&M ticket

ApplyUsername.description_en: The username of the user who submitted the O&M ticket

ApprovalStatus.description_en:
The approval status. Valid values:
1: Pending approval.
2: Processed
ApprovalStatus.description_zh: 审批状态 1 待审批。2 已处理
ApprovalStatus.title_en: 审批状态 1 待审批。2 已处理
ApprovalStatus.title_zh: 审批状态 1 待审批。2 已处理

ApproveComment.description_en: The remarks entered by the O&M engineer when submitting the O&M ticket
ApproveComment.description_zh: 运维人员申请运维时填写的备注

AssetAccountId.description_en: The ID of the asset account requested for O&M

AssetAccountName.description_en: The logon name of the asset account requested for O&M
AssetAccountName.description_zh: 申请运维的资产账户登录名

AssetAddress.description_en: The address of the asset requested for O&M

AssetId.description_en: The ID of the asset requested for O&M

AssetName.description_en: The name of the asset requested for O&M

AssetNetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the asset requested for O&M belongs
AssetNetworkDomainId.description_zh: 申请运维的资产所属的网络域ID

AssetOs.description_en: The operating system type of the asset requested for O&M
AssetOs.description_zh: 申请运维的资产操作系统类型

AssetSource.description_en:
The name of the asset source to which the asset requested for O&M belongs. Valid values:
Local: Local host.
Ecs: ECS instance.
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
The name of a third-party asset source
AssetSource.description_zh:
申请运维的资产所属资产源的名称。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS实例
第三方资产源名称

AssetSourceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the asset source to which the asset requested for O&M belongs
AssetSourceInstanceId.description_zh: 申请运维的资产所属资产源的ID

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M ticket was submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 提交申请的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

EffectCount.description_en:
The limit on the number of logons requested by the O&M engineer. Valid values:

0: No limit on the number of logons. The O&M engineer can log on an unlimited number of times within the validity period.
1: The O&M engineer is allowed to log on only once within the validity period
EffectCount.description_zh:
运维人员申请的登录的次数限制。取值：

0：不限制登录次数，运维员在有效期内可以无限次数登录。
1：运维员在有效期内只允许登录一次

EffectEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the O&M session specified by the O&M engineer. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
A value of 0 indicates that the O&M engineer did not specify an end time when submitting the ticket
EffectEndTime.description_zh:
运维人员填写的申请可以运维的结束时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
返回为0时表示运维人员在申请时未填写时间

EffectStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the O&M session specified by the O&M engineer. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
A value of 0 indicates that the O&M engineer did not specify a start time when submitting the ticket
EffectStartTime.description_zh:
运维人员填写的申请可以运维的开始时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
返回为0时表示运维人员在申请时未填写时间

OperationTicketId.description_en: The ID of the O&M ticket pending approval
OperationTicketId.description_zh: 需要审批的运维申请单的ID

ProtocolName.description_en: The name of the protocol requested for O&M

State.description_en:
The approval status. Valid values:

Normal: Pending approval
State.description_zh:
审批状态。取值：

Normal：待审批

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of O&M tickets pending approval
TotalCount.description_zh: 待审批的运维申请单总数
